candidates.title: 3x3 Door With Interlocking Block Open/Close Sequence
proposed_controls: Use the saved lever at (6,1,4). Capture one complete close/open cycle to determine safe dwell, then require two complete cycles. Author explicitly says it is not spam-proof.
proposed_checks: Compare every tick-end block state and comparator output to vanilla.
Verify complete panel opening/closing and exact return of all mechanism blocks.
Preserve the seven redstone items across three droppers and hoppers; compare occupied slots every tick.
Repeat at negative origin and rotated placements to test the author's orientation/location claim separately.
notes: Native save is already DataVersion 4671, matching the 1.21.11 reference.
Uses copper bulbs, crafters, observers, pistons and inventory timing; adds coverage beyond the existing doors.

candidates.title: Bottom-Accessible Shulker Loader (AL001)
proposed_controls: Seed replacement empty boxes in dispenser (0,2,1); saved containers are empty.
Supply items via hopper (0,1,0), which faces the box at (0,1,1). Verify input route in vanilla first.
For a compact rollover case, seed that box with 1727 ordinary 64-stackable items, then deliver one final item; also capture an empty-input negative control.
proposed_checks: Full box is broken, collected, and replaced with an empty box.
All 1728 contents survive inside the emitted/collected shulker item; no duplication or loss.
Compare replacement timing, all block states and comparator outputs.
Run a second refill/replacement cycle once the single-cycle reference passes.
notes: Archive describes single hopper-speed operation and reliable collection.
Independent parity requires nested shulker-item contents and item-entity capture beyond the current flat-slot driver.

candidates.title: 1x CUD-based loader (OL004)
proposed_controls: Supply a finite mixed batch through input hopper (0,3,2), facing the box at (1,3,2), then stop input.
Keep the saved empty-box stock and comparator OutputSignal values; record initial occupied slots before ticking.
Determine the fader timeout from vanilla, then test bursts separated by shorter and longer gaps plus a zero-input control.
proposed_checks: End-of-input detection replaces a partly filled box after the fader timeout.
Each mixed item appears exactly once in the emitted box; no item remains unintentionally buffered.
Compare the actual comparator outputs, not only powered block properties.
Compare box replacement and item-entity paths under identical finite inputs.
notes: Archive attributes design to Kizu; the file's saved author is auraa42. Preserve both.
Contains water and packed ice; needs nested shulker contents and item-entity capture before independent parity can be claimed.

candidates.title: Plane Flying Machine
proposed_controls: Establish launch on vanilla by a controlled front-face block update to the tail observer at (25,2,16), facing east. This is a topology-derived candidate, not an author-specified verified launch.
Reserve a fully ticking travel corridor and capture repeated movement before introducing a tail-only stop; author warns that stopping another part can break the plane.
proposed_checks: At matching settled cycle boundaries, the full 252-block machine is an exact translation, with no stranded parts or lost blocks.
Compare every tick-end in-flight and landed state to vanilla, including branching slime/honey assemblies.
Require repeated movement, controlled stop, and restart; preserve observer/piston event ordering through differential traces.
notes: Listing says version any; actual saved DataVersion is 4556.
No inventories or entities initially, so block capture is a useful first check.
Download requires a browser-like User-Agent and its token may expire; refresh the link from the source page rather than accepting changed bytes.
